note: Fictional example. No value is ever stored here: only what each secret is, what it is for, who uses it, and how to rotate or revoke it. Paths are relative to the local secrets folder (PAROS_SECRETS_DIR).

policy.oauth_refresh_token: no fixed rotation; revoke on suspicion or when a machine is lost
policy.leaked: rotate at the provider immediately, then update this row and the transfer bundle

secrets.purpose: read the inbox for the daily triage
secrets.revoke: provider account settings, Security, Third-party access, remove the app
secrets.notes: re-authorise with the connector's add command; never paste the token into a chat

secrets.purpose: speech to text for meeting recordings
secrets.access: transcription endpoints only, spending limit set at the provider
secrets.revoke: provider console, API keys, delete the key

secrets.kind: the machine's own private key (encrypted with a passphrase)
secrets.purpose: opens this machine's slot in the encrypted transfer bundle
secrets.access: decrypts every secret sent to this machine
secrets.revoke: remove the machine's public key from the keyring and re-export the bundles
secrets.notes: never leaves the machine; the passphrase is stored nowhere

removed.where: moved to the local _backup folder, revoked at the provider
